plugins.name: Workflow Canvas
plugins.author: Nexus Labs
plugins.description: Create and run node-based workflows with draggable cards and line connections.
plugins.configureHint: Open Workflow Canvas from Settings and connect nodes using input/output ports.

info.title: Workflow Canvas
info.what: Adds a node whiteboard under Settings to build connected workflows.
info.how: Add nodes, drag them, connect OUTPUT to INPUT, then run looped execution order.
info.usage: Enable plugin, open Workflow Canvas and create linked nodes for macros/automations/key actions.
notes: Supports loop count and per-step delay.
